tei:div.tei:p: rdo rje gro lod brgyud 'debs ni/ khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// ye shes sgyu ma'i gar mkhan rdo rje sems// rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul dga' rab rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// mkhyen rab sprul pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*// blo mchog mnga' ba shri sengha'i zhabs// dngos grub (8)mchog brnyes dzñā na sū tra la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsaul// mkha' grub chen po bi ma la mi tra// rang byung chen po pad+ma saṃ bha ba// tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs rje 'bangs grogs gsum la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig klong chen pa// lde gsum klong dgu'i rgyan gcig 'jigs med gling*// thub bstan yongs rdzogs rgyan gcig ngag gi dbang*// gsol ba (9)'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// bla ma spyi 'dus rdo rje gro bo lod// yi dam yongs 'dus dbang chen rta mchog dpal// mkha' 'gro kun 'dus pad+ma gzi ldan la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// ye shes klong dgu rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro ging*// rang gdangs ma 'gags rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha// rig rtsal rang grol dam can chos skyong la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub (10)stsaul// rdo rje'i gtor blugs cho gas rgyud smin cing*// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig srog rtsa brtan// bskyed bzlas mthar phyin nus pa'i gding chen thob// rdzogs pas phyag rgya'i ye shes mchog 'grub shog /srung ba'i rdzogs bstan zlog pa'i dmag dpung 'khrigs// bsad pa'i mtshon chas lus sems kha sbyor dbye// mnan bsreg 'phang pas dgra bgegs tshar bcad de// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mthu thob shog /rta skad thengs gsum gzhi lam 'bras (11)(12)bu'i rgyud// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi la// brten nas rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i lam bgrod de// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog
